question: What auspicious method for overcoming time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The desired teaching is an auspicious overcoming of time
inference: The speaker now seeks instruction on the auspicious overcoming of time.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ can mean deception or outwitting; rendered as overcoming in this context.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious means of overcoming time.
